source: ACL 2025 — LLM-Enhanced PEAD via Abstractive Earnings Summaries
title: H304: LLM-Augmented PEAD — GPT-4o-mini Abstractive Summary + Sentence-BERT Embeddings
rationale: ACL 2025 paper demonstrates that replacing FinBERT direct scoring with (1) GPT-4o-mini abstractive summarization of earnings transcripts + (2) sentence-BERT contextual embeddings of summaries yields consistent OOS improvement in PEAD signal quality. FinBERT baseline achieves 57.6-58.3% classification accuracy; LLM-augmented version improves meaningfully. Our H163/H174 pipeline already uses FinBERT on 8-K filings — this is a direct upgrade path. Two variants to test: (A) abstractive summary only (GPT-4o-mini) → FinBERT score, (B) sentence-BERT embedding similarity score as replacement for FinBERT CLS. IS: 2018-2021, OOS: 2022-2026. Gate: OOS win-rate > 81.8% (H174 baseline) OR mean return > 6.89%.
